title: RadioShack — Custom checkout, validation, and event tracking
summary: Checkout optimization for RadioShack with client-side validation, load improvements, and normalized event tracking for analytics.
context: Magento 2 store focused on checkout conversion: the client wanted to reduce form friction, control the quality of captured data, and better understand user behavior at each step of the funnel.
challenges: Reduce checkout load time without losing compatibility with existing extensions.
Validate buyer data (address, identification, contact) before sending it to the backend.
Capture relevant funnel events to feed Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager.
Show contextual error messages without breaking the flow.
approach: Checkout refactor in Magento 2 on top of Knockout.js, RequireJS, and LESS, keeping the native module contracts.
Progressive client-side validation that surfaces errors only when the user leaves a field or tries to advance.
Data layer with normalized events for checkout, payment, and confirmation.
Checkout asset optimization: bundling, deferred loading, and selective prefetch to reduce time-to-usable-byte.
outcomes: Checkout with stricter validation and contextual error messages.
Event layer ready for Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4.
Improved checkout load time, subject to final metrics pending confirmation.
Abandonment and conversion metrics pending validation before publishing.
